learned_rules: Avoid Grid Hard Stop-Loss (LONG) triggers at or above -0.5%, as this resulted in massive losses.
Utilize Grid Trailing Stop (LONG) to lock profits at a minimum of 0.0105% and consider increasing the lockout threshold based on market conditions.
Implement an AI Bias Bullish Trigger with a grid that has a sufficient number of steps and a wide enough price range to capture potential gains while minimizing losses.
